styles.name: White 100% organic cotton bib apron with a centre front pocket, self fabric ties and the standard Bettys logo — Tibard, Bettys Cookery School
styles.desc: BIB APRON · AP3005B (smaller size), variant Betty's · Self fabric neck strap · Self fabric waist ties · Centre front pocket 23 × 28 cm (9" × 11") · Tibard printed care label · Standard Bettys logo embroidered to the centre of the bib in maroon thread
styles.lectra: AP3005 — model AP3005B (the smaller size), variant BETTY'S
fabrics: White 100% organic cotton X149ECO AM05 260 gsm (Tiajo) — rating 0.50 m, the same as All Costings; the sheet writes the code as C05001ECO at A6, Sage holds CO5001ECO at A3
trims: THREAD — WHITE PERMA CORE 75 20000 M CONE 32109W (Somac) — cost per metre. The sheet says white Coats 80's; Sage holds no white Epic code, so the white Perma Core the other white styles use.

Tibard printed care label, set 4 cm down from the top of the finished right side seam as worn: 100% cotton · 40° wash · tumble dry low · 2 dot iron · do not bleach · P dry clean. Printed at Tibard on the 25 mm nylon label tape.
Self fabric, two per apron: no bought-in tie. Fold in half, enclose the raw edges and edgestitch the long edge to close.
Self fabric: fold in half, enclose the raw edges and edgestitch the long edge to close.
mfg: Make the waist ties: fold in half and enclose the raw edges. Edgestitch the long edge to close the seam.
Make the neck strap: fold in half and enclose the raw edges. Edgestitch the long edge to close the seam.

Set the bib facing and insert the neck strap. The edge of the neck strap to finish in line with the side of the bib (no step). The edgestitched side of the neck strap to the outside edge of the bib, good side of the strap to the top.
Top of the bib: 6 mm topstitched.
Bib facing: fold in 10 mm to neaten the lower edge. Edgestitch the lower edge of the facing, which forms a 5.5 cm topstitch on the front.
Armholes: double turned and topstitched to finish 6 mm from the edge. Neaten the armholes before the side seams are neatened.
Hem: double turned and topstitched to finish 12 mm from the edge.
Sides: double turned and topstitched 12 mm. Insert the care label to the right side seam as worn.
Insert each waist tie neatly into the top of the side seam turning. Do not roll the tie above the apron seam.
Fold each waist tie back on itself to fall away from the garment and edgestitch down to the width of the strap to secure.
Pocket hem: double turned and topstitched 1 cm.
Set the pocket centrally to the front, the bottom of the pocket 33 cm (13") up from the finished hem. Edgestitch in position. Triangle tack the top corners to secure.
styles.tol: Width ± 1 cm · Bib ± 0.5 cm · Neck strap ± 1 cm · Length ± 1.5 cm
styles.brandPlace: Standard Bettys logo (see artwork) embroidered to the centre of the bib in maroon thread.
styles.note: Works order BEAPPCS300501 for Betty's Cookery School (JH created 15/12/16; embroidery amended from the Cookery School logo to the standard Betty's logo and the sheet updated; fabric from CO2001 3113 to CO5001 3110 JH 13/6/24; fabric to Tiajo organic eco from 3110 P&R and the model corrected from APP3005 to AP3005B JH 13/1/26; issued by Gail). The Betty's version of the white bib apron on the smaller AP3005B pattern: self fabric ties in place of the stock AP300501's tape ties, a standard 23 × 28 cm centre front pocket, and the logo. The logo is the record's own branding, so it is not a stock style: the sales order's logo lines are not printed on top of it. Rating 0.50 m on CO5001ECO, the same as All Costings. The sheet is in works-orders/BEAPPCS300501-Bettys.xlsx.

styles.name: Cumbria chef jacket — short sleeve, storm grey
styles.desc: Short sleeved with double turned straight hems, twin needle · Panelled back · Front concealed press stud fastening · Standard pen pocket LHSAW · Black OH Made in Great Britain neck tape
styles.lectra: OH4 — Cumbria — short sleeves, variant OH4SSLV
fabrics: Storm grey 65% recycled polyester / 35% organic cotton 200 gsm X133 AM299 (Tiajo) — the sheet gives no rating; 1.55 m from All Costings, as the white and black Cumbrias. The sheet gives the location as A3, Sage holds the cloth at A5
trims: THREAD — COATS EPIC 80'S STORM GREY 09963 — cost per metre
10 nickel plated ring press studs per jacket, concealed fastening. No Sage code on the trims list.
Oliver Harvey woven label set to the centre back neck.
Oliver Harvey wash label: 65% recycled polyester 35% organic cotton · 60° wash · 2 dot iron · low tumble dry · P dry clean · do not bleach. Set inside the left side seam as worn.
Label for the garment name and the manufacturing month and year only, behind the wash label in the side seam.
Black Oliver Harvey Made in Great Britain tape, set to the lower edge of the collar from facing to facing. No Sage code on the trims list for the tape.
Oliver Harvey red tax tab in the pen pocket towards the back of the sleeve — no red to show through the pocket.
mfg: Straight sleeve hems — deep hem, twin needle.
13 cm stitched down the front panel.
Concealed press stud fastening.
Panelled back.
Mandarin collar edgestitched at the top edge.
Black Made in Great Britain ribbon inserted in the back neck.
Oliver Harvey British button woven label at the centre back neck.
Oliver Harvey wash label in the side seam LHSAW, the product code label behind it.
Standard pen pocket on LHSAW with a centre seam, bartacked before make-up.
Red tax tab in the pen pocket towards the back of the sleeve — no red to show through the pocket.
Deep double bottom hem with twin needle.
fin: Individually wrapped in OH tissue paper.
styles.note: Works order OHCJSCUMBRIA--248, the storm grey short sleeve Cumbria chef jacket, created for Rocksalt / Mark Sargeant (studs from 7 to 10 YL 3/1/18; fabric and supplier YL 15/5/18; OH embroidered hem logo removed YL 13/9/19; fabric from Utexbel PCUTEX01 YL 31/8/22; grey created for Miele RCR 346 and the short sleeve grey RCR 368 JH 19/1/23; eco fabric, supplier and code YL 25/10/24; created for Rocksalt RCR 422 JH 21/5/25). The embroidery box on the sheet is empty, so a plain OH jacket: the sales order's logo lines print as usual. Sage carries the sizes as OHCJSCUMBRIA38248, 42248 and so on. The size chart is the 34" to 62" Cumbria short sleeve chart the black jacket uses: the sheet's figures are the same. The sheet is in works-orders/OHCJSCUMBRIA-248-StormGrey.xlsx.

styles.name: Tibard chef trousers, elasticated waist with drawstring and back pocket — regular length, black
styles.desc: Chefs trousers · Full elasticated waist with drawstring · Zip fly · One patch pocket on the back · Side seam pockets · Hemmed · Regular length · Black
styles.lectra: NEW 3082 — variant NEW3082RL, regular length; sizes 46" to 60" cut on the XXL to 5XL patterns
fabrics: Black 65% polyester / 35% cotton — the sheet gives no rating; 1.60 m from All Costings. The sheet names the P and R cloth PC2003 at B11; Sage and All Costings carry the sustainable PC2003ECO (Tiajo) at B1
trims: THREAD — COATS EPIC 80'S BLACK 09700 — cost per metre
Black plastic oval two-hole spring toggle on the drawstring. Sage holds the black spring toggle (large); use that code if it is the same toggle.

48 mm white elastic with the black drawstring insert. Cut, and double stitch to secure: XS 22" (56 cm) · S 24" (61 cm) · M 28" (71 cm) · L 31" (79 cm) · XL 33" (84 cm) · XXL 35" (89 cm) · 46" 36" (91.5 cm) · 48" 38" (96.5 cm) · 50" 40" (101.5 cm) · 52" 42" (106.5 cm) · 54" 44" (111.5 cm) · 56" 46" (116.5 cm) · 58" 48" (121.5 cm) · 60" 50" (126.5 cm). Sage holds the plain white 48 mm Bonadex elastic; no code for the drawstring-insert elastic yet.

Tibard printed care label set into the back rise seam, 8 cm down from the finished top edge: 65% polyester 35% cotton · 60° wash · do not bleach · tumble dry · 2 dot iron · can be dry cleaned. Printed at Tibard on the 25 mm nylon label tape.
Tibard tax tab set to the side edge of the back pocket (outside leg side of the pocket), the top of the label to the base of the pocket hem stitching.
mfg: Cut the elastic to the size (see the Elastic trim line) and double stitch to secure.

Set the buttonholes vertical for the drawstring, 1/2" buttonhole setting. Set equally within the width of the fly placket (2 cm gap between the buttonholes), the top of the buttonhole 6.5 cm from the top overlocked edge of the band, to finish within the centre gap of the stitch lines.
5 thread join up: pocket bags to the legs, outside leg seam, front and back rises, inside leg seam.
Set the back pocket hem double turned and topstitched 1.5 cm.
Top of the finished pocket set level with the notch in the back outside leg. Pocket set centrally within the width of the back leg and parallel to the top edge.
Fold in 1 cm and edgestitch the pocket down onto the back leg.
Edgestitch the front side pocket opening. Pocket opening to finish 17 cm.
Set the zip and topstitch the fly. Fly width 4 cm, curved at the base.
Edgestitch the front rise from the base of the fly stitching.
Overlock the top edge of the trouser. Set the elastic to the waist: 4 rows of stitching on the waist, twin needle at the top and twin needle at the base.
Trouser hem double turned 1 + 1.7 cm and topstitched 1.5 cm.
fin: Plastic oval two-hole toggle placed on the drawstring, the ends of the drawstring tied into a double knot.
Bartack horizontal across the top and bottom of the side pocket opening. Bartack vertical at the back pocket patch opening. Bartack vertical at the base of the fly.
Check and trim. Fold into quarters.
styles.tol: Waist relaxed, waist stretched, leg length and hips ± 2 cm
styles.note: Stock works order CT3082--03 (NEW 3082 variant NEW3082RL; JH created 24/4/14 to be the exact fit of the OH Lancashire trouser waist with the style details of the previous CT3082, relaxed waist measurements based on cut measurements and to be reviewed; 1/2" buttonhole blade setting YL 9/4/15; big sizes JH 7/2/17; cut cord lengths YL 16/6/21; Tibard Style moved YL 9/10/24; processed by Gail).
